verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the Developer Platform API is defined by an OpenAPI 3.1 specification and include a codegen guide for generating typed clients from it, which implies a downloadable machine-readable spec. The probe's 404s at guessed standard paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, etc.) show the spec isn't at a conventional location, but that does not contradict the documented spec, which may live at another URL. Missing for 10: an explicit download URL in evidence, a successful hands-on retrieval of the spec, coverage of the Widget API (not just the Platform API), and independent corroboration.
